prompt:
Task: you are checking sentences for faithfulness to a source. Each item is one sentence meant to say exactly what its source span says, read in its context. Some items are correct; others contain one subtle change of meaning. Judge each item on its own.
For each item answer two questions separately: (1) Does the source span, read in its context, support everything the sentence says (nothing stronger, wider, added, or attributed to the wrong thing)? (2) Does the sentence keep everything material the span says (qualifiers, negations, comparisons, conditions, who does what)?
Output one line per item, nothing else, in this exact form: M001 | supported: yes/no | keeps: yes/no | ok: yes/no | reason if any no (max 12 words)
Cover all 150 items in order. English only. Do not skip items or summarize.
